jobs.title: Contract manager
jobs.description_text: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity. The Exploration Company builds complex space systems under contracts with government and institutional customers. Programs of this kind evolve: requirements change, design maturity improves, schedules shift, and suppliers and customers request adjustments. Each change must be formally proposed, assessed, negotiated, and recorded in the contract before it can be executed and paid for. As Contract Manager, you will own the change lifecycle for your assigned contracts. You will drive Contract Change Notices (CCNs) from initial request to signature, protect the company's position on scope, cost, and schedule, and keep the contract baseline accurate for the program team. Our mission is to eliminate weather uncertainty, and in the process help humanity adapt to climate change, be that predicting hurricanes or speeding the adoption of renewables. We are building a future in which the planet is instrumented by thousands of our microballoons, eliminating gaps in our understanding of the planet and giving people and businesses the information they need to make critical decisions. You'll be launching high-altitude weather balloons that collect atmospheric data used to improve forecasts for events like hurricanes and wildfires. About 10a Labs: 10a Labs is the safety and threat-intelligence layer trusted by frontier AI labs, AI unicorns, Fortune 10 companies, and leading global technology platforms. Our adversarial red teaming, model evaluations, and intelligence collection enable engineering, safety, and security teams to stay ahead of evolving threats and deploy AI systems safely.

About the role

You’ll review and label content and flag imminent-risk cases for escalation, working as part of a small crew so you’re never reviewing this content alone.

Schedule

This is an evening role: 4:00 PM–12:00 AM ET, five days a week. Crews work either Sunday–Thursday or Tuesday–Saturday, so every schedule includes one weekend day. 

What you'll do

  • Review and label content, and flag imminent-risk cases for escalation
  • Apply policy consistently and document your decisions clearly
  • Bring edge cases to the senior specialist on your shift on weekdays, or to the client’s designated contact on weekends
  • Take part in quality reviews and calibration, and apply feedback
  • Hand off clearly to the next shift

What we're looking for

  • 2+ years reviewing violent content, credible threats, or violent extremist material in a Trust & Safety, content moderation, or investigative context

jobs.description_text:
About Avride

Avride delivers exceptional, technology-driven transportation experiences. Our fleet supports safe, clean, and efficient mobility solutions that meet the highest standards in the industry. Every vehicle and every team member plays a key role in ensuring quality, safety, and reliability around the clock.

About the Role

The Fleet Associate is responsible for cleaning, sanitizing, charging, and performing light technical inspections on Avride’s autonomous vehicle fleet. This role ensures that every vehicle is connected, updated, and ready for deployment, addressing both cleanliness and basic maintenance needs to support daily fleet performance.

Available Shifts

  • Report any mechanical or safety issues promptly to the Operations or Fleet Maintenance team.
  • Move vehicles safely around the lot and in and out of charging bays.

jobs.description_text:

Why it matters: The most important stories aren’t always the most obvious. We're looking for a creative, ambitious editor who can spot the trends others are missing, connect the dots across beats and help turn smart ideas into must-read coverage. 

Go deeper: In this role, you’ll make an impact through the following responsibilities:

  • Generate distinctive enterprise ideas and work with reporters to turn them into stories that break through.
  • Work across the politics team and the newsroom to connect the dots between beats and identify opportunities for collaboration.

Worthy of your time: Ideal candidates will embody an entrepreneurial spirit and passion for Axios’ mission and have the following skills:

  • Reporting experience in a fast-paced news environment.
  • Demonstrated experience landing big scoops and conceptualizing big ideas.
  • Strong writing skills for online and newsletters. 
  • A belief in Smart Brevity as the core writing style of Axios.
  • A commitment to building and nurturing a diverse and inclusive environment.&nb

jobs.title: Reporter, News
jobs.description_text:
1 big thing: Axios is a media organization dedicated to providing trustworthy, award-winning news in an audience-first format. We're hiring for a writer-editor to lead the afternoons and evenings on our newsdesk. 

Why it matters: Reporting to our Executive Editor, the news writer-editor will play a critical role as part of the 24/7 nerve center for the newsroom.

  • We are after people with a “see it, write it” mentality who have a personal passion for news and a fast-twitch set of journalistic reflexes.
  • This is a job for the news junkies who “monitor the situation” for fun and want to do it for a living. 
  • We operate at one cadence - do it right now - and are after people who marry a love of news with the thrill of being busy.  
  • This is the ultimate “safe pair of hands” job — someone we can trust to both edit the work of others and write their own, too. 

Go deeper: The role comes with a range of responsibilities, including:

  • Real-time news surveillance
  • Quick-turn writing of spot news stories
  • Editing a wide variety of national news, from breaking stories across the national file to the occasional enterprise.
  • Monitoring developments on key stories and flagging them to experts

WHAT IS BOX?

Boxについて
Box(NYSE: BOX)はインテリジェントコンテンツ管理（ICM）プラットフォームのリーディングカンパニーです。Boxのプラットフォームは、企業のコラボレーション促進や、コンテンツのライフサイクル全体の管理、重要なコンテンツの保護、そしてエンタープライズAIによるビジネスワークフローの変革を実現することを目指しています。2005年に米国で設立され、JLL、モルガン・スタンレーなどを含む大手グローバル企業や、日本では約23,000社および日経225の86%の企業の業務効率化を支援しています。
Boxは、カリフォルニア州レッドウッドシティーに本社を置き、米国、ヨーロッパ、アジアに拠点を持っています。株式会社Box Japanは2013年に設立された日本法人です。

Boxでは、重要なコンテンツを扱うプラットフォームをさらに推進し、お客様の働き方に大きな変革を提供する、またとない機会があります。コンテンツは私達の業務の中心にあります。契約書、請求書、社員情報、財務情報、製品仕様、マーケティング資産などの部署間に跨る重要なビジネス・プロセスに含まれる数十億ものファイルや情報が日々流れています。私達のミッションは、コンテンツ管理にインテリジェンスをもたらし、お客様がデジタル・トランスフォーメーションを実現するお手伝いをさせていただくことです。このAIと膨大な業務コンテンツの融合による、大規模な働き方の変革期に、そのビジネスの最前線に貢献することが、Boxではできます。

WHY BOX NEEDS YOU 

K.K. Box JapanはBox Inc.の日本支社として2014年5月に設立され、急成長し続けています。私たちはさらにBoxを広め、ともに成長を促進していただくことができる人材を求めております。このポジションでは日本のセールスチームの一員として、責任を持ってセールス活動に専念していただくことができます。

  • CIOやIT executive LOB executive、また他の主要なstakeholderとも密に関わって信頼関係を築く
